content.short: MetaCRM is a Web3-native customer relationship management platform providing on-chain CRM, analytics, and user support tools for Mantle dApps.
content.description: MetaCRM is the first decentralized customer relationship management platform designed specifically for Web3 protocols and dApps. By analyzing on-chain wallet data and behavioral patterns, MetaCRM enables protocols to understand their users, segment audiences, and deliver personalized engagement  all without requiring users to provide personal information. The platform integrates with Mantle dApps to provide customer support ticketing, user analytics, and targeted communication tools that respect user privacy while improving protocol-user relationships.
content.meta: MetaCRM is a Web3 CRM platform providing on-chain user analytics and support tools for Mantle dApps. Discover MetaCRM on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
